hypotheses.text: Deploy d-3121 ('card validation refactor') broke confirmation for orders above roughly $2,000; the differing symptoms are three surfaces of the same backend failure.
hypotheses.not_examined: No access to code, server logs, or the deploy diff. The $2,000 threshold is inferred from two tickets that mention amounts; other tickets do not state order values.
